top_choice_rationale: General palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling for Buchwald and Hartwig is the one proposal whose impact is measured rather than forecast: free amines and base replaced the toxic aminostannane of 1983, mechanistic work on amido and reductive-elimination steps and ligand design made it predictable, and three decades of use in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis confirm it. The two-name allocation is clean, Kosugi can be acknowledged as precursor, and the citation should stress 'general' to avoid a priority dispute and to answer the 2010 C-C coupling overlap. Pairing it with base editing (P001) is acceptable but adds a part I consider protein engineering after the 2020 prize; ionizable lipids (P003) are a defensible physical-chemistry design principle with a narrower citation; Liu alone (P004) is clean on attribution but weakest on what is new chemically.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund colleague of Linke and Sparr, no tie to any proposed laureate
